### int-l7805abd2t-dropout-headroom

<EvidenceAnchor id="int-l7805abd2t-dropout-headroom" />

- **Records involved:** `rec-l7805abd2t-c86206` (this record)
- **Conditions:** U7 operating point on Board B: +7.5 V DC-DC rail input, 5 V output, 0.5 A rated load. Available headroom 2.5 V vs Vd 2 V typical specified only at IO = 1 A, TJ = 25 degC; no guaranteed dropout at any current, and the rail equals the exact lower edge of the DS0422 guaranteed input band (VI = 7.5 to 18 V), leaving zero guaranteed margin for DC-DC tolerance/ripple. Bench-confirm regulation margin when the L7812 bench gate is exercised
- **Verdict:** NEEDS BENCH

## Legend

What the recorded terms on this page mean, in ordinary words. The exact terms above are the ones that count; these descriptions explain them and never replace them.

### Verdict

| Recorded term                     | What it means                                                                                       |
| --------------------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `NEEDS BENCH`                     | Cannot be settled from documents. It needs measurement on real hardware before it can be relied on. |
| `NOT APPLICABLE`                  | The parameter does not apply to this part as it is used here.                                       |
| `PASS - primary-source confirmed` | Confirmed against the manufacturer's own document for this exact part.                              |

### Provenance

| Recorded term    | What it means                                                                                                                                       |
| ---------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `CALCULATED`     | Derived arithmetically from other facts listed here. The expression and every input are shown, so the number can be recomputed rather than trusted. |
| `PRIMARY-SPEC`   | Taken from the manufacturer's own specification document.                                                                                           |
| `PROJECT-CHOICE` | A decision made by this project. No vendor asserts it.                                                                                              |

### Fact class

| Recorded term           | What it means                                                                                                                                                      |
| ----------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| `ABSOLUTE_MAXIMUM`      | A never-exceed limit. Reaching it may damage the part; it is not an operating target and there is no margin implied by it.                                         |
| `GUARANTEED_ELECTRICAL` | A parameter the manufacturer guarantees over the stated conditions, usually with minimum, typical and maximum values.                                              |
| `PROJECT_STATE`         | A value this project recorded about how the part is used here — a chosen operating point, a net assignment, or a derived figure. Not a manufacturer specification. |
| `RECOMMENDED_OPERATION` | The range the manufacturer intends the part to be used in. Always narrower than the absolute maximum.                                                              |
| `THERMAL_SOA`           | Thermal and safe-operating-area behaviour: how much the part may dissipate, and under what mounting and ambient conditions.                                        |
| `TYPICAL_CURVE`         | A representative figure read from a characteristic curve. Typical values are not guaranteed and vary part to part.                                                 |

### Coverage status

| Recorded term | What it means                                                                                                               |
| ------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `COVERED`     | Every question this domain asks is answered by the facts listed against it.                                                 |
| `OPEN`        | Unresolved. Open means the question has not been answered, not that the part is unsafe — the reason states what is missing. |

### Source availability

| Recorded term | What it means                                |
| ------------- | -------------------------------------------- |
| `AVAILABLE`   | The document was retrieved and is on record. |

### Source authority

| Recorded term          | What it means                                                             |
| ---------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `MANUFACTURER_PRIMARY` | The manufacturer's own document for this exact part.                      |
| `PROJECT_GENERATOR`    | A document this project generated, such as a schematic or netlist export. |

### Identity state

| Recorded term | What it means                                                 |
| ------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `VERIFIED`    | The exact orderable part has been confirmed against a source. |

### Source state

| Recorded term | What it means                                          |
| ------------- | ------------------------------------------------------ |
| `AVAILABLE`   | At least one document backing this line was retrieved. |

### Unit

| Recorded term | What it means                                                                      |
| ------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `NONE`        | The value is not a physical quantity, so it carries no unit. Recorded as \`NONE\`. |
